authorization_basis: Explicit human start authorization relayed by the new-task dispatch; preparation readiness was not treated as authorization.

settings.target: The complete Theorem 1 of the supplied paper, including its method, standing definitions, hypotheses, quantifiers, parameter ranges and conclusion.
settings.source_policy: Use the selected skill's ordered retrieval and conditional-source reporting; never turn an inaccessible original into an unqualified PASS.

mathematical_source_policy: Original supplied PDF only; the declared material is its owner-checked notation transcription, not another proof/source. Ordinary isolated-controller retrieval may follow.

source_readback.text_extraction: pypdf-text as bound by local preparation and job; all original pages extracted and read
issues: pypdf flattens fractions, superscripts and subscripts
Fourier reality conjugation bars disappear from plain extraction on pages 2 and 11
source_readback.resolution: Complete source-faithful target and explicit source-math-transcription.md checked against rendered pages; no new proof, hypothesis or source added.
source_readback.mathematical_verdict: Not a proof audit; independent construction/review remains pending.

current_acceptance_semantics.audit_a: independent global and complete local R reviews
current_acceptance_semantics.normal_final_audit_b: machine validation against independently reviewed frozen authority

measurement.concurrent_host_resources: Shared host/account; no isolated speed claim

exclusions: No sibling benchmark or old-run result read
No direct-model arm or extra Codex task
No other proof skill or personal research guidance supplied
No production edits, toolchain changes or resampling
